directions.quote: The RedemptionOrderConfirmation message is sent by an executing party, for example, a transfer agent, to the instructing party, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative, to confirm the details of execution for a previously received RedemptionOrder message.

narrative.quote: The RedemptionOrderConfirmation message is sent by an executing party, for example, a transfer agent, to the instructing party, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative, to confirm the details of execution for a previously received RedemptionOrder message.
narrative.raw_quote:
Scope
The RedemptionOrderConfirmation message is sent by an executing party, for example, a transfer
agent, to the instructing party, for example, an investment manager or its authorised representative, to
confirm the details of execution for a previously received RedemptionOrder message.

unclassified_narrative.quote: The RedemptionOrderConfirmation message is used to confirm the execution of one or more individual orders.

Usage
The RedemptionOrderConfirmation message is used to confirm the execution of one or more individual
orders.

unclassified_narrative.quote: A RedemptionOrder message containing more than one individual order may be responded to by more than one RedemptionOrderConfirmation message, as the valuation cycle of the financial instruments in each individual order may be different.
